items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So me and little McCollum, George McCollum, nice little trumpet player, made up a good bunch of fellas and started playing around here.

ctx.x: Nat Toe was the bass player. Nat Toe stuff evening. I went on to Cincinnati Journal, I like to come back to New Orleans. And I come back and I settle down there. And it was going so good. I played with Sidney a little while, but Sidney was a funny fellow with that stuff, you know. Yeah, I've heard that. That money. Yeah, I've heard that. The old Roche, we call him Roche. Roche liked that money so well. He messed with the money so much. So me and little McCollum, George McCollum, nice little trumpet player, made…
